source_snapshot.title: Over Dh20 million in prizes up for grabs at the Dubai Shopping Festival 2026-2027
source_snapshot.text: Dubai: Dubai is gearing up to launch the new edition of the Dubai Shopping Festival, running from December 4 to January 17, 2027. The festival will feature 1,000 brands and 4,000 stores, offering prizes worth over Dh20 million across 45 days of promotions, raffles, and entertainment. This season aims to revitalise the market, boost consumer spending, and attract more shoppers and visitors to the emirate. During a press conference in Dubai, officials and representatives from participating entities unveiled a diverse programme, combining retail offers, cash prizes, gold, cars, real estate, concerts, and entertainment experiences, further solidifying Dubai's position as a global destination for shopping, tourism, and entertainment. Exceptional experiences Ahmed Al Khaja, CEO of Dubai Festivals and Retail Establishment (DFRE), part of Dubai’s Department of Economy and Tourism, said: “For over three decades, the Dubai Shopping Festival has established itself as a highlight of Dubai’s winter season, a recurring event to celebrate and explore the city’s exceptional experiences. Today, in its 32nd edition, we continue this legacy with a program that reflects Dubai’s vibrant and ever-evolving character, offering experiences that transcend traditional shopping to encompass entertainment, culinary arts, culture, and adventure, alongside special offers and valuable prizes. Through this edition, we aim to provide even more reasons for Dubai residents and visitors to explore the city and enjoy all that it has to offer.” He added: “What distinguishes the Dubai Shopping Festival is its ability to reinvent itself year after year, while maintaining its unique character that has made it one of the city’s most prominent seasonal events. This year’s edition includes new experiences and innovative concepts, alongside the core events that the public eagerly anticipates, in a program that stretches from Dubai’s beaches to its urban and natural destinations in Hatta. We are also keen to ensure that the festival’s impact extends beyond mere celebration by highlighting local businesses and providing opportunities for various sectors to capitalise on the season’s momentum. As part of ‘Dubai’s Season of Discovery,’ we invite everyone to embark on new experiences, explore destinations they have never visited before, and enjoy moments together with family and friends, making Dubai’s winter a season full of memories.” Exceptional awards Firas Erekat, Vice President of Retail Calendar and Promotions at Dubai Festivals and Retail Establishment, affirmed that the new edition of the festival reinforces its economic role in stimulating markets and attracting shoppers and visitors from around the world. He noted that the festival has continued to evolve since its inception in 1996, becoming one of the most prominent events supporting the retail, tourism, and hospitality sectors in the emirate. It offers a wide range of promotions and raffles, giving shoppers the chance to win prizes including a kilogram of gold, shopping vouchers worth Dh500,000, a luxury car, an apartment, and Dh1 million in cash, in addition to grand prizes totalling Dh3.5 million. Erekat pointed out that the diversity of offers and events contributes to stimulating consumer spending and boosting the performance of stores and shopping centres, as well as attracting more international visitors to a festival that serves as an important platform for strengthening partnerships between the public and private sectors and supporting the growth of commercial and tourism activities, in line with the objectives of Dubai's D33 economic agenda. Dh20 million in prizes Abdullah Al Amiri, Vice President of the Commercial Partnerships and Retail Promotion Sector at the Dubai Festivals and Retail Establishment, one of the institutions of the Department of Economy and Tourism in Dubai, confirmed that the total prizes allocated for the festival exceed Dh20 million, with the participation of more than 3,000 brands and thousands of stores, noting that the growth rates of the retail sector vary according to seasons and events, and range between 5% and 10% in light of the continuous growth that Dubai is witnessing and the expansion of its commercial and tourism activities. The new edition will see the participation of more than 22 shopping centres in various areas of Dubai, with prizes worth Dh1 million allocated within the Wheel of Fortune campaign, including cash prizes ranging between Dh10,000 and Dh30,000, in addition to including a Nissan Magnite car for the first time among the prizes, with weekly opportunities to win a car, which enhances the turnout at shopping centres and stimulates commercial activity in residential complexes and community areas. This is in addition to the raffle campaign in cooperation with Enoc, which includes prizes worth Dh3.8 million, and in-kind prizes worth more than Dh200,000. title: Over Dh20 million in prizes up for grabs at the Dubai Shopping Festival 2026-2027
summary_ru: 🛍 Dubai Shopping Festival 2026-2027: призы на сумму более 20 млн дирхам 📅 Фестиваль шопинга в Дубае пройдет с 4 декабря 2026 по 17 января 2027 года. В нем примут участие 1000 брендов и 4000 магазинов, предлагая призы на сумму свыше 20 млн дирхам. 🎭 В программе фестиваля — розыгрыши, концерты и развлечения, а также призы: золото, автомобили, недвижимость и денежные выплаты. Среди главных призов — килограмм золота, автомобиль Nissan Magnite и денежные призы до 1 млн дирхам.
